summary: Colombian trafficker Griselda Blanco helped build the cocaine trade into the US from the 1970s, turning Miami into a war zone through hundreds of killings, and kept running her network from prison until her 2012 murder in Medellin.

evidence.note: born in Cartagena in the early 1940s, moved to Medellin as a small child
alcoholic mother beats her regularly as a child
at eleven she shoots a kidnapped ten-year-old
Queens trafficking operation with Bravo in the late 1960s, first cartel cocaine in US by 1971
moves to Miami in 1978 and floods it with cocaine
Cocaine Wars segment: Dadeland shooting, murder rates, morgue overflow
third husband killed on her orders with their young son in the car
arrest, plea deal and prison life, later murder indictments
long segment on Charles Cosby, her prison lover and business partner
witness scandal with prosecutor's office secretaries collapses the murder case
released in 2004, shot by a motorcycle gunman in Medellin in 2012
postscript on her son's 2018 vape and clothing brand trading on her name
